_instructions.quick_start: Copy this file to Data/Config/LLM/gemini.json (for global use) or Portfolios/<PortfolioName>/LLM/gemini.json (portfolio-specific) and paste your Google API key into 'api_key'.

key_types.paid_pay_as_you_go: RECOMMENDED. Create an API key at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey linked to a Google Cloud Billing account (Pay-As-You-Go Tier 1/2). This tier gives high RPM/TPM rate limits without the strict 20-request/day Free Tier cap.
key_types.free_tier: Google AI Studio Free Tier keys are supported, but have a strict limit of 20 requests per day for gemini-2.5-flash. Exceeding 20 requests produces HTTP 429 errors and displays a red '🔴 (quota/429)' dot in the UI. If you use a Free Tier key, consider using gemini-2.5-flash-lite for higher free limits.
key_types.external_cli_agents: NOTE: External terminal agents ('agy', Claude Code, Gemini CLI) connect via the opt-in 'holdings-tools' MCP server rather than this file. In-app AI Chat and Saved Prompts use the HTTP API key configured here (or GEMINI_API_KEY) and enforce your active Privacy Shield mode.
key_types.vertex_ai: For Google Cloud Vertex AI enterprise endpoints, you can update 'api_base_url' to your regional Vertex AI endpoint and provide a Google Cloud Service Account Bearer token or Gateway API key.

_instructions.environment_variable_alternative: Instead of pasting your key here, you can set export GEMINI_API_KEY='AIzaSy...' in your shell (~/.bashrc or ~/.zshrc). If 'api_key' in this file is empty or starts with 'PASTE_YOUR_', AdvisorBot will automatically read GEMINI_API_KEY from your environment.
_instructions.privacy_shield: When Privacy Shield is enabled (Portfolio Settings -> Privacy), account names, trust titles, and holdings are aliased locally before sending to Google, and re-translated upon response.
